Difference between well-formed and valid?
well-formed means syntactically correct (tags closed, nested correctly, attributes quoted, exactly one root element); valid means it also satisfies a DTD or XSD structural constraint (which elements may appear, their order and types). This tool checks the former; for the latter you must supply the corresponding schema definition.
